notes.title: Version 0.9.4r1: Whale Scene Update, Bug fixes. New instagram page!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're excited to bring you another update with version 0.9.4r1! This update focuses on improving the overall game experience and squashing some bugs that you've reported.
What's new in this update:


Visual improvements: We've enhanced the whale scene with improved visual feedback, making it easier to play.
Bug fixes: A range of small bugs have been addressed to ensure a smoother gameplay experience.


Want to help us translate or join the community?

If you're interested in contributing to the game’s translation or want to chat with the team, feel free to join our Discord community: https://discord.gg/QHpJmmh7pe

You can also follow us on our new Instagram for updates and sneak peeks:
https://www.instagram.com/fear.the.void.official/

As always, thank you for your support, and we can't wait for you to experience the latest improvements!

Best wishes,
The ECS Team

notes.title: Version 0.9.3r1: Polish language added, QOL fixes
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

We're proud to announce that Polish language has been added to the game!
W razie literówek lub problemów z formatowaniem tekstu, proszę dajcie znać na naszym serwerze Discord :)

After attending the Sofia Game Jam in April, we've gathered some of your feedback and fixed some of the stuff you mentioned to us.

- Camera shake when running is now adjustable
- Loading screens shortened
- FOV adjustment now properly interacts with screens in game
- Central dot (crosshair) now disappears when the game takes control over the player
- Tooltip added to the 'Extra Pixelated' setting*

*The purpose of the setting was not exactly clear when we implemented it, as it makes a difference only on bigger screens. We added that as a tooltip in the Settings!

It's been a long few months for us, since we're cooking something in the meantime. Check our Instagram for the latest updates!
https://www.instagram.com/extracosmic.studios/

Thank you for your support as a community. It really means the world to us, and we can't be thankful enough for your engagement in our work. Stay tuned to the updates!

Much love,
ECS Team

notes.title: Version 0.9.2r1 is live now! Ukranian Language is available!

- wrong triggering of some cinematics
- gun was not displayed correctly sometimes at the begining of final level.

For those of you who are interested to help out with translation, here is link to our discord server: https://discord.gg/QHpJmmh7pe
